# chameleon_quality_run (Resource)

Triggers a data-quality run for a contract (POST /quality/run). One-shot: inputs force replacement, so a new run is triggered whenever they change. `status` and `score` are refreshed on read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chameleon_quality_run" "orders_dq" {
  contract_id = "contract-1"
  scope       = "full"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contract_id` (String) Contract to run quality checks against.

### Optional

- `scope` (String) Run scope. Defaults to "full".

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Equals run_id.
- `run_id` (String) BFF-assigned run id.
- `score` (Number) Quality score (0.0-1.0) if reported. Refreshed on read.
- `status` (String) Run status (passed, failed, error). Refreshed on read.
